component.name: Synctrain
component.summary: Synchronize folders, or open a gateway's folders on demand

description.p: Synctrain keeps folders in step with Syncthing, or shows the folders of a gateway on another system and fetches their files as they are opened. It runs in one of two modes on each machine.

ul.li: Synchronize: Syncthing runs here, every folder syncs all of its files, and phones and other machines can reach the folders through its remote file service.
Files: no Syncthing runs here. The folders of a gateway on another system appear in ~/Synctrain, and files are fetched as they are opened, kept for working offline, and sent back when they change.
